title: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for this spine fixation application needing intermediate strength between CP and Ti-6Al-4V with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile with 20% elongation provides 30% weight reduction vs steel. This rationale is driven by spinal fixation connection rod (grade 9 / beta-ti) and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for spine fixation geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod suitable for Spinal fixation connection rod (Grade 9 / Beta-Ti)?
faq.a: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod uses Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address spine fixation operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. spine fixation components receive Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Spinal rod / Fixation rod spine fixation components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
